content_text: If you are shooting digitally, you could try setting your camera to the ISO/shutter speed/f-stop you’d like to shoot at, turn on the LED lights at full, then by looking at an accurate monitor or your viewfinder if it has some exposure tools (zebras or false colors), start dimming the lights down individually until you like it.
